title: 上海高考翻译背诵-65-25一模黄浦

items.zh: 这款饮料由水果和蔬菜汁混合而成，味道很好。
items.en: This drink, a combination of fruit and vegetable juices, tastes great.

items.zh: 下了一周雨后，天气变得阳光明媚，还真令人感到愉悦。
items.en: After a week of rain, the weather turned bright and sunny, which is a real delight.

items.zh: 无论从哪个方面看，写作都是一个有百利而一害，且适用于每个普通人的技能。
items.en: From any perspective, writing is a skill that brings nothing but benefits and applies to every ordinary person.

items.zh: 包括新手小白和高级玩家在内的多位受访者表示，他们热衷于攀岩是因为这项运动需要他们富有创造性地解决问题。
items.en: Many respondents,, ranging from beginners to advanced climbers, said that they love climbing because it require creative problem-solving.
